brief: Holds one code rule, a graph rule over a code graph, whose finding carries the line of the offending code.
detail: A code rule is a stzGraphRule in the code domain. Its checker queries a stzCodeGraph, which models real method definitions and real call edges, instead of scanning text, so a comment that says def len is not a method and a method definition named substr is not a call. The house rules are declared in stzCodeRuleSet, and StzCheckCode runs them over source.
